Title: how can i type-annotate a function that creates an object literal out of a literal key and a value?
Description: i have
```typescript
const key: 'name' = 'name';
const value: number = 1;
```

i need a function that turns these key/value into an object with a property, in JavaScript it would look like:
```javascript
// javascript
function(key, value) {
    return { [key]: value };
}
```

so that:
```typescript
const data = fn(key, value);
// data is expected to be of type: { name: number; }
```

is there a way to type-annotate `fn` so that it returns an object of type `{ name: number; }`? if so, how?
